caption: Herculaneum ruins, Ercolano
composition: Deep excavated multi-storey Roman houses with Vesuvius beyond · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks across the deep excavation of Herculaneum, where the roofless shells of multi-storey Roman houses stand preserved in the 08:29 morning light. Faded red and blue frescoes still color the plastered walls at center, timber beams and empty window frames exposed, while the shadowed streets drop away on both sides. Beyond the ruins the modern town climbs toward the broad blue silhouette of Vesuvius, and the hazy horizon stretches to the sea.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Herculaneum ruins in Ercolano under clear morning light
